The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `3306` (see `MariaDbBuilder.MariaDbPort`)
- Environment variable: `MARIADB_DATABASE=mariadb` (see `MariaDbBuilder.WithDatabase(string)`)
- Environment variable: `MARIADB_USER=mariadb` (see `MariaDbBuilder.WithUsername(string)`)
- Environment variable: `MARIADB_PASSWORD=mariadb` (see `MariaDbBuilder.WithPassword(string)`)
- Environment variable: `MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD=mariadb` (see `MariaDbBuilder.WithPassword(string)`)
- Wait strategy: Waits until the `mariadb` client runs `SELECT 1;` successfully.
